crossRefs.note: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the prostitute’s house, and bring the woman and all…

translations.web: He showed them the entrance into the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.
translations.bsb: So the man showed them the entrance to the city, and they put the city to the sword but released that man and all his family.
translations.kjv: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.
translations.asv: And he showed them the entrance into the city; and they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man go and all his family.
